== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Master Qui-Gon (V) (AI) (Virtual Block 5)]] (the AI printing), showing the '''original''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee AI card image ([[:File:VB5-L-masterquigonai-pre.gif]], marked E) shows the PC-E1 text. Rendered without the E mark.

* '''Text source:''' the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip #45 of the base card, [[:File:VB5-45-Master_Qui_Gon.png]]) and the PC website card list entry for the AI printing (2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11). Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''Original text:''' “Deploys -1 to [Episode I] locations. If you just lost Force from an opponent’s Effect, may ▲ an [Episode I] Interrupt (except Control), or place a card from hand under Credits Will Do Fine. Immune to Disarmed, You Are Beaten, and attrition.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1250_44ai</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with this game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
